text: The process of managing people in an organisation to achieve goals is
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: HRM is concerned with acquiring developing and retaining people effectively.

text: Which of the following is a function of HRM
subject: Human Resource Management
options: Recruitment and selection|Preparing balance sheets|Market pricing|Debt collection
explanation: Recruitment selection training and compensation are core HRM functions.

text: The systematic process of determining the skills duties and knowledge required for a job is job
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Job analysis yields job descriptions and job specifications.

text: Human resource planning ensures the right number of people with the right skills are available at the right time
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: HRP forecasts demand and supply of people to avoid shortages or surpluses.

text: Distinguish between job description and job specification
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: A job description states the duties and responsibilities of a job while a job specification states the qualifications and qualities required of the person doing it.
explanation: Description is about the job while specification is about the job holder.

text: Explain the objectives of human resource planning
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: HRP aims to forecast manpower needs match supply with demand prevent shortages and surpluses and support organisational growth while controlling labour costs.
explanation: Cover forecasting balancing supply and supporting strategic plans.

text: The process of attracting a pool of qualified applicants is
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Recruitment attracts candidates while selection chooses the best among them.

text: Recruitment from within the organisation through promotion or transfer is called
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Internal sources fill vacancies from existing employees.

text: Selection is a negative process because it rejects unsuitable candidates
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Selection screens out unqualified applicants while recruitment is positive.

text: List the steps in the selection process
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Screening applications tests interviews reference checks medical examination and job offer.
explanation: These steps narrow the applicant pool to the best candidate.

text: Explain the sources of recruitment
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Recruitment sources are internal such as promotion and transfer or external such as advertisements campus and employment agencies. Internal sources motivate staff while external sources bring fresh talent.
explanation: Contrast internal and external sources with their merits.

text: The process of improving the skills of employees for their current job is
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Training builds skills for the present job while development prepares for future roles.

text: The systematic evaluation of an employees performance against standards is performance
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Performance appraisal assesses how well an employee meets job standards.

text: Training is a short term process while development is long term
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Training is job focused and short term while development is career focused and long term.

text: List any four methods of training
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: On the job training classroom lectures simulation role playing and case study.
explanation: These methods develop employee skills in different ways.

text: Explain the process of performance appraisal
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Appraisal begins with setting standards then measuring performance comparing it with standards and giving feedback followed by corrective action and development planning.
explanation: Trace the appraisal cycle from standards to feedback.

text: The reward paid to employees for their work in the form of wages salary and benefits is
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Compensation includes all monetary and non monetary rewards for work.

text: Wages paid to workers on the basis of units produced is called
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Piece wage links payment to output rather than time worked.

text: Fringe benefits are non monetary benefits such as housing and medical facilities
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Fringe benefits supplement wages with facilities like housing medical care and transport.

text: Distinguish between time wage and piece wage systems
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Time wages pay for the hours worked while piece wages pay for the quantity produced.
explanation: Time rate rewards attendance while piece rate rewards output.

text: Explain the importance of employee welfare measures
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Welfare measures like canteens medical care and housing improve employee morale health and commitment reduce absenteeism and help attract and retain talent.
explanation: Cover morale health and retention benefits of welfare.

text: The relationship between employers and employees through unions and collective bargaining is
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Industrial relations cover the employer employee union relationship.

text: The negotiation between employers and unions over wages and conditions is collective
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Collective bargaining settles terms of employment through negotiation.

text: Employee engagement reflects the emotional commitment of employees to their organisation
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Engaged employees are committed enthusiastic and willing to go the extra mile.

text: List the causes of industrial disputes
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Wage demands working conditions retrenchment union recognition and poor management practices cause disputes.
explanation: Economic and managerial issues underlie most industrial disputes.

text: Explain the importance of employee engagement
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Engaged employees are more productive loyal and innovative which reduces turnover and improves customer satisfaction and profitability.
explanation: Link engagement to performance retention and business outcomes.

text: Assertion: Induction helps new employees settle quickly. Reason: Induction familiarises them with the organisation and their role
subject: Human Resource Management
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion|Both are true but reason does not explain assertion|Assertion is true but reason is false|Assertion is false but reason is true
explanation: Induction reduces anxiety by explaining policies and the role to newcomers.

text: Match the HRM activity to its purpose
subject: Human Resource Management
options: Recruitment - attract applicants|Selection - attract applicants|Training - evaluate performance|Appraisal - choose candidates
explanation: Recruitment attracts while selection chooses and appraisal evaluates.

text: The process of introducing a new employee to the organisation and its culture is
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Induction orients new employees to the organisation and their colleagues.

text: The upward movement of an employee to a higher position with more responsibility is
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Promotion moves an employee to a higher post with more pay and responsibility.

text: Job rotation moves employees between jobs to broaden their skills
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Job rotation is a training and development technique that widens experience.

text: Explain the merits and demerits of internal sources of recruitment
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Internal recruitment is cheaper and faster and motivates existing staff. Its drawbacks are limited choice possible inbreeding and missed fresh ideas from outside.
explanation: Balance morale and cost benefits against limited talent pool.

text: Explain the factors influencing wage and salary administration
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Compensation is influenced by ability to pay prevailing market rates cost of living productivity and government legislation along with union pressure.
explanation: Cover internal and external determinants of pay.

text: Read the case: A company has high turnover and employees complain of poor growth opportunities. Suggest HR measures to improve retention
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: The company should introduce clear career paths training and development fair appraisal and recognition to improve engagement and reduce turnover.
explanation: Propose engagement and development measures addressing the stated complaints.

text: Read the case: A department hires a skilled worker who then underperforms because he never received orientation. Diagnose the problem and suggest a solution
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: The employee lacked induction so he did not understand expectations and culture. The firm should provide structured induction and on the job support to integrate him.
explanation: Link poor onboarding to underperformance and propose induction.

text: Which appraisal method compares each employee against every other employee
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Paired comparison ranks employees by comparing them in pairs.

text: A job description focuses on the person while a job specification focuses on the job
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: The description focuses on the job while the specification focuses on the person.

text: The process of assessing the relative worth of jobs to determine pay is job
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Job evaluation ranks jobs by difficulty to establish fair pay.

text: Explain the objectives of training and development
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Training develops skills reduces errors and builds confidence while development prepares employees for future responsibilities and supports succession planning.
explanation: Distinguish short term skill building from long term development.

text: List the principles of wage and salary administration
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Internal equity external competitiveness performance linkage simplicity and flexibility.
explanation: These principles ensure a fair and motivating pay structure.

text: The voluntary separation of an employee from the organisation is called
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Resignation is a voluntary separation initiated by the employee.

text: Dismissal is termination of employment initiated by the employer due to misconduct
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Dismissal is employer initiated termination often for misconduct.

text: Explain the importance of human resource management in modern organisations
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: HRM attracts develops and retains talent aligning people with strategy. It improves productivity morale and competitiveness and manages change and diversity.
explanation: Link HRM to organisational performance and competitive advantage.

text: Define grievance and list the stages of the grievance procedure
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: A grievance is an employee complaint about work conditions. It is handled through supervisor then higher management then arbitration stages.
explanation: The procedure escalates the complaint through successive levels.

text: Explain the difference between personnel management and human resource management
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Personnel management is a reactive administrative function focused on employees as a cost. HRM is a proactive strategic function treating people as assets to be developed.
explanation: Contrast the scope philosophy and strategic role of the two.

text: The process of identifying and developing internal people to fill key positions is succession
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: Succession planning prepares internal candidates for future leadership roles.

text: Explain the methods of performance appraisal
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Appraisal methods include traditional ones like graphic rating and essay and modern ones like management by objectives and 360 degree feedback.
explanation: Contrast traditional and modern appraisal techniques.

text: Explain the role of HRM in building organisational culture
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: HRM shapes culture through hiring values aligned people induction training reward systems and leadership development reinforcing desired behaviours.
explanation: Link HR practices to reinforcing cultural values.

text: A strike is a temporary stoppage of work by employees to press their demands
subject: Human Resource Management
explanation: A strike is a collective work stoppage by employees during a dispute.

text: Explain the concept and importance of job design
subject: Human Resource Management
correctAnswer: Job design structures the tasks duties and responsibilities of a job to improve motivation and efficiency through techniques like job rotation enlargement and enrichment.
explanation: Cover the meaning and the techniques of job design.
